principle: Never describe a scaffold or UI-only control as a finished capability.

features.name: Android native keyboard input
features.notes: InputMethodService commits text through InputConnection; real device QA is pending.

features.name: iOS Custom Keyboard Extension
features.notes: The native UIInputViewController and keyboard extension build successfully in iOS Simulator CI on commit aceda3f1ce1cee93c35be218c89c11e22766e546. The newer privacy update is rebuilding; physical-device install/signing and system keyboard QA remain pending.

features.name: Arabic and English layouts
features.notes: Basic Arabic and English rows and language switching exist. Android Arabic long-press now exposes common alif/hamza variants and ten combining marks; full language-specific layouts, comprehensive punctuation, mixed-script cursor behavior and RTL device QA remain.

features.name: YORY Studio
features.notes: Local preset, color, opacity and geometry controls; live IME reload behavior requires device verification and further controls.

features.name: Tinted glass rendering
features.notes: Translucent panel and key surfaces; platform-specific background blur/refraction is not yet implemented.

features.name: Offline word completion
features.notes: Starter local prefix lists now use Arabic search-only normalization for alef/hamza variants, tashkeel and tatweel, and include a curated starter set of Egyptian conversational terms on Android and iOS. Candidate text is returned in its original spelling. This remains prefix completion only, not autocorrect, neural prediction or a quality-certified dialect model.

features.name: Personal learning dictionary
features.notes: Opt-in local word learning is implemented on Android with AES-GCM/Android Keystore and on iOS in a local App Group shared only by the host app and keyboard extension. Incognito pauses learning; secure-field exclusions apply. Settings include an explicit clear action; starter prediction quality and physical-device privacy QA remain.

features.name: Emoji picker
features.notes: Native Android and iOS keyboard emoji panels include curated categories, up to 24 recent choices stored locally, favorites via long-press, direct insertion and selectable skin-tone modifiers for a starter people/hand set. Text search, full Unicode catalogue and comprehensive localization remain open.

features.name: Alternative emoji artwork
features.notes: Artwork licenses and recipient-app rendering constraints must be respected.

features.name: Clipboard history manager
features.notes: Android-only, opt-in text history. Entries are encrypted with AES-GCM under an Android Keystore key, capped at 50, unpinned items expire after 24 hours, and the manager supports search, pin/unpin, re-copy, delete, undo and clear. OTP/PIN/payment-number filters are heuristic, not a guarantee; iOS background clipboard history is not provided.

features.name: Screenshot/image import
features.notes: User-initiated image selection only where supported; no promise of background screenshot harvesting.

features.name: Custom sound packs
features.notes: Standard Android click effect and iOS system keyboard click are wired. User-imported/custom sound packs and per-key sound overrides are not implemented.

features.name: Keyboard haptics
features.notes: Android keyboard tap haptics and iOS light impact feedback are wired to settings; real-device behavior and user/system setting interactions remain unverified.

features.name: 120-language target catalogue
features.notes: Catalogue only. Language packs and quality certification are not shipped.

features.name: Encrypted dictionary backup
features.notes: No user words are uploaded in plaintext; client-side encryption implementation is still required.

features.name: Standard key sound and light haptics
features.notes: Uses platform-standard click/haptic APIs and local user preferences; physical-device QA is pending.

features.name: Cross-platform .yorytheme import/export
features.notes: Versioned schema v1, validation, local file import/export in both host apps; cross-platform round-trip needs device QA.

features.name: Input-aware layouts and editor actions
features.notes: Planned capability or partial platform slice; not production-ready until acceptance criteria and device tests pass.

features.name: Long-press alternate characters
features.notes: Android exposes English accent variants and, in Arabic mode, common alif/hamza alternatives plus ten combining marks (eight standard tashkeel marks, dagger alif and madda above) through a horizontally scrollable accessible popup. iOS full Arabic mark-set parity, insertion/touch behavior and physical-device QA remain.

features.name: Unicode-supported emoji skin tone variants
features.notes: A user-selectable tone selector is available for the starter people/hand emoji set on Android and iOS. Coverage for the complete Unicode emoji set and compound ZWJ sequences is not yet implemented.

features.name: Pinned, expiring and manageable local clipboard items
features.notes: Android clipboard manager supports pin/unpin, 24-hour expiry for unpinned clips, search, copy again, delete, undo last deletion and clear all. Sensitive-value detection is heuristic; this feature is Android-only.

features.name: Local editable personal dictionary and learning controls
features.notes: Opt-in local learning is implemented in Android with AES-GCM encryption via Android Keystore and in the iOS keyboard extension sandbox; it can be disabled and cleared locally. Requires physical-device privacy/lifecycle QA and richer model evaluation.

features.name: Local language-aware autocorrect
features.notes: A conservative on-device spelling-correction prototype uses a small curated English/Arabic correction map plus a unique one-edit candidate fallback. Android now restores the original word when Backspace is pressed immediately after an automatic correction. This is not context-aware prediction; lexical coverage, language-specific evaluation and physical-device QA remain.

features.name: Keyboard toolbar visibility and ordering
features.notes: Platform-specific tools can be reordered and shown/hidden with local persisted preferences; essential keyboard-switch/settings actions are retained. Verify extension lifecycle refresh and all widths on physical devices.

features.name: Session-scoped incognito typing
features.notes: Session toggle suppresses predictions and local learning on both platforms; Android also pauses clipboard capture. It resets when a new keyboard input session appears. Physical-device privacy tests remain pending.

features.name: Local emoji favorites
features.notes: Long-press an emoji to add/remove it from local favorites; the Favorites category displays saved items. Favorites remain device-local and physical-device accessibility/touch QA is pending.

features.name: Offline keyboard language layouts
features.notes: Seven offline letter layouts are wired on both platforms: English US, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese and Italian. Bundled starter prefix dictionaries are currently only English and Arabic; the remaining layouts have no shipped prediction model. The 120-language catalogue remains a target list.

features.name: Free and premium entitlements
features.notes: A monetization catalogue defines free and planned premium benefits, but no billing SDK, purchase UI, prices or live entitlements are implemented. Do not show purchase CTAs until platform billing, restore, refund and support flows pass review.

features.name: Optional online registration invitation
features.notes: Source implementation exists on Android and iOS: a delayed, dismissible native YORY Studio invitation for guests when online, with a local 30-day frequency cap and a later Account settings entry. Initial localizations: Arabic, English, German, Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese; device region takes priority and Arabic uses RTL. No location or notification permission is requested. CI and physical-device UI, connectivity, localization and accessibility QA remain; upcoming cloud services are not claimed as currently available.
